# CBD American Shaman of Hurst - Full Site Information
CBD American Shaman of Hurst offers CBD, hemp, Delta-9 THC gummies, tinctures, seltzers, and wellness products.
All products comply with the 2018 Farm Bill (< 0.3% Delta-9 THC by dry weight).
